generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The Javadoc for `getThreadPoolNames()` says "for operations on this **system index**", but this interface now covers both system indices and system data streams. The wording should be "system resource" to match the interface's scope.
Javadoc typo: `@link Metadata}` should be `{@link Metadata}`. The opening brace is missing, so the Javadoc link will not render.

This adds a "Test System Data Stream" (feature `"sds-1"`, data stream `".sds-1"`) to `SERVER_SYSTEM_FEATURE_DESCRIPTORS` in the server module. This appears to be test scaffolding that should not be in production code. Every Elasticsearch node would register this system data stream, which is almost certainly unintended. If this is needed for integration tests, it should be registered via a test plugin (similar to how `AbstractFeatureMigrationIntegTest.TestPlugin` registers `SYSTEM_DATA_STREAM_DESCRIPTOR`) rather than in the server's static feature map.

The error message `"error occurred while reindexing data stream [" + migrationInfo + "]"` relies on `SystemDataStreamMigrationInfo.toString()`, which is not overridden. The default `Object.toString()` will produce something like `SystemDataStreamMigrationInfo@3f2a1b4c`, making the log message unhelpful for debugging. Use `migrationInfo.getDataStreamName()` (or `migrationInfo.getCurrentResourceName()`) instead.

review_comment: Why is this no longer needed?

At 1198 of this file `feature.getIndexDescriptors()` has changed to `feature.getSystemResourceDescriptors()` which includes both indices and data streams. The rest of the removed code was essentially the same as there, so now remaining code covers both indices and data streams.
